verdict.rationale: Docs confirm AutoGen has a logging/tracing feature for 'traces and internal messages' and a separate AutoGen Studio UI for building/testing/running teams, but no evidence explicitly ties these together into a UI that visualizes per-call LLM/tool traces for a given run. Missing for 10: explicit documentation or screenshots of an observability/tracing UI showing individual LLM calls and tool invocations, and any independent corroboration of this capability.
